title: Château of Blois
scope: Standing Royal Château of Blois across its historic courtyard, with the medieval hall, Louis XII gate wing, François Ier loggias and stair, Gaston d’Orléans range, Chapelle Saint-Calais and Tour du Foix.
limitations: Mapped roof and part heights are approximate. Courtyard grades, fine sculpture and details of partially hidden elevations are interpreted. Interiors and unrelated neighboring buildings are outside the model.
